title: An inverse-square-root inequality
statement: For natural numbers $k$ and $n$ with $1\leq k$ and $2k\leq n$, one has $\left(1-\frac{k+1}{n}+\frac{k}{n^2}\right)^{-1/2}\leq 1+\frac{2k}{n}$.
